class safe_vamd.stratified_atmosphere.density_stratified_atmosphere.RhoStratAtmo(z0: float, g: MathFunc, rho0: float, t: MathFunc, air_properties: AirProperties)¶

Bases: MathFunc

A class that computes the density in hydrostatic equilibrium with the acceleration of gravity and the temperature profile and implements it as a subclass of MathFunc:

z0¶

Reference height (in meters).

Type:

float

g¶

The acceleration of gravity (in m/s) implemented as a MathFunc.

Type:

MathFunc

rho0¶

Value for the air density (in kg/m^3) at the reference height (z0).

Type:

float

t¶

The air temperature (in Kelvins) field implemented as a MathFunc.

Type:

MathFunc

air_properties¶

The air properties (specific ratio of heats and perfect gas constance) implemented as a AirProperties object.

The air density field implemented as a MathFunc object.

MathFunc

AirProperties

Computes the derivative with respect to height of the air pressure using the perfect gas law.

float
